items.q: What water tank size suits a landed house?
items.a: For a typical landed house, a 1000L tank like the King Kong stainless steel 1000L (RM 2,914 supply & install) is enough for family water storage. We can recommend a larger size during the site survey.

items.q: How long does water tank and pump installation take?
items.a: Most water tank and water pump installs are done in a single day. A tank + pump + filter combo package usually finishes in one visit too.

items.q: Do the water tank and pump come with warranty?
items.a: Yes. Every brand — King Kong, Grundfos, Hitachi, Tsunami — comes with a manufacturer warranty. We also provide after-install support over WhatsApp.

items.q: Which water pump is better — Tsunami or Grundfos?
items.a: Tsunami (from RM 1,800 supply & install) suits budgets and standard homes. Grundfos (from RM 3,600) is quieter and more durable for larger homes or high pressure. We'll help you choose based on your needs.

items.q: What does the 6-layer water filter remove?
items.a: The 6-layer filter removes sediment, rust, chlorine, odour, and fine impurities before water enters your home. It protects your piping and water heater and makes water clearer.

items.q: How much do I save with a combo package?
items.a: A tank + pump + filter combo (from RM 5,411) costs less than buying and installing each item separately, and everything is installed together in one visit.

items.q: Do you supply and install across Malaysia?
items.a: Yes, we supply and install water tanks, water pumps, and water filters across Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, and Sarawak. WhatsApp your location to confirm coverage and get a quote.

items.q: Do you remove old water tanks?
items.a: Yes. Our team can detach and remove a rusty or leaking old tank before installing a new King Kong stainless steel unit. Let us know during the site survey.
